name: hud_cmd_dialog_state_on_try_become_current
description: HudCmdDialogState::OnTryBecomeCurrent allocates and constructs the HUD command dialog, stores it on the state, enables the dialog through its container vtable, suspends keyboard input, and returns success.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the HudCmdDialogState/HudCmdDialog source-file cluster. Current source preserves the unconditional virtual SetEnabled dispatch observed after storing the constructed dialog pointer; exact VC5SP3 byte comparison remains a later pass.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja evidence for 0x40bcf0 shows operator new(0xce00), conditional HudCmdDialog::Constructor after successful allocation, storing the resulting pointer at self+4, an unconditional indirect call through vtable slot +4 with enabled=1, zInput::Keyboard_Suspend, and return value 1.
